text_block_list.name: Young Crown
text_block_list.text:
Papa! Mama! Want to go here!
This "Satono Grand Resort" in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Remember gripping Satono Group brochure until wrinkled,
begging busy parents until they agreed.

text_block_list.name: Young Crown
text_block_list.text:
Really? You will take me?
No backing out, okay? Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Also remember girl pictured there,
with sparkling smile.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: In——

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: In——

text_block_list.name: Cheval & Shion
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...
Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Woohoooo! We are total celebs now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Satono Grand Resort!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hotels, malls, nature activities fully integrated!
World-renowned dream resort, pride of Satono!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mission: PR shoot celebrating renewal completion!
Going to take absolutely stellar shots!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what do we do, Shion... Nobody mentioned
such incredible place...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well... came all this way, but...
Are we really fit to model...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hehe, of course! Picked you myself. Absolute faith in my eye.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Major PR project marking multi-year renewal works.
Success here makes massive group contribution ——

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Plus loved place since visiting as child.
Personally want more people knowing it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let us put heart into shoot.
Counting on everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Accepted role, so strive only for perfection.
Giving our all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Great spirit! ...Let us begin!
Crafted detailed plan, no worries!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Unleash natural charm, Vivlos.
Hit camera with full energy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All right, camera☆ Do not hold back!
Snap away! Make it cute♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Fufun♪ Like this? Or... this? ...Hey, Crown! Thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: OK! Looking great!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Plan for pair: highlight Duramente's sleek style
and Shion's refined ballet posture.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Duramente never gets rattled by this. Impressive.
I cannot help feeling jittery.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Shows true mental readiness for anything.
Trait worth learning from.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Photo shoots not rare for me.
Though purpose here differs slightly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Shion still looks tense.
Tea break to unwind?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Cheval next. Plan was capturing pure, honest charm
against scenery poses, but ——

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Different level of stiff.
No rush, break till afternoon to reset.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Could not look up at all...
Modeling just impossible for me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-no, cannot stay like this.
Because ——

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: M-model?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Satono Group gig. Interested?
Think resort photo tour.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... was nobody else available?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No... just, big sister and Vivlos
fit this so much better...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Asked you first, Cheval.
Join in, and shots will look stunning.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-why think that...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Shine brighter than you realize.
Your radiance captivates... Want to capture that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Hope you join.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Want to shine. Brightly, like Crown said.
Must meet expectations... Have to.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Resuming. Duramente, keep morning pace. Shion,
adjusted poses and angles for easier focus. Take look.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Also tweaking hairstyle for fresh look!
Stylist already briefed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Went to so much trouble for me... So sorry.
...Tomorrow will deliver without fail.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Vivlos, keep riding that natural charm.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay☆
Camera crew, treat me well♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Cheval... start by getting comfortable with lens.
Tweaked plan so no direct eye contact needed.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: O-okay...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
This time... will do properly...
Like... proper magazine model...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Right... Sis did Twinkle Weekly cover recently...
Remember... remember...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Cheval? Shoot starting... Ready?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huah?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
H-huh...? Which way look again...?
Pose was... umm, ummmm ——

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Like this!
..........Eh?
